dedupe_keys.name: climate smart intercommunal business park kreilhof waidhofen an der ybbs austria

description: A Climate-ADAPT case study of an industrial estate designed for heavy rain and heat. It says the municipality of Waidhofen an der Ybbs in Lower Austria developed the Kreilhof business park, about 60,000 square metres of former farmland in the Ybbs valley, with rules for companies on green spaces, permeable parking, on-site rainwater storage and energy-efficient buildings; it serves six businesses and 12,000 square metres of municipal business space. Planning began in August 2019 and works ended in December 2022, at a total cost of 1.3 million euros, with green-area maintenance of about 10,000 euros a year. Hot days in the region are projected to double to about 11 a year. The case study page is free to read online, with no download. Coverage is one business park. Caveats: no measured performance in storms or heatwaves is given; the licence is the EEA reuse policy. For simulation it gives a design and cost reference for reducing flood and heat risk at industrial sites. A related catalogue record is the DERRIS Turin case study.
